source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of antiviral and antiretroviral drugs (PDF 212).

blocks.text: Antiviral dawaen virus infections ka ilaaj karti hain. Yeh jism mein viruses ki barhotri aur afzaish rokti aur bohat se viruses, jin mein hepatitis, influenza aur herpes viruses shamil hain, ka muqabla kar sakti hain.

Antiretroviral dawaen retroviruses, jin mein HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) shamil hai, se hone wali bimariyon ka ilaaj karti hain. Yeh immune system ke difa mein madad aur HIV ko barhne se rokti hain. Retroviruses aise viruses hain jin ka genetic maadda RNA hai aur jo enzyme reverse transcriptase se afzaish karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ka dabba
blocks.text: Sab antiretrovirals antivirals hain, lekin sab antivirals antiretrovirals nahi.

blocks.prompt: Antiviral aur antiretroviral dawaon mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Antivirals aam viruses (jaise hepatitis, influenza aur herpes) ke khilaf; antiretrovirals khaas taur par HIV jaise retroviruses ke khilaf jo reverse transcriptase use karte hain.

items: Antiretrovirals: HIV aur doosre retroviruses (RNA genome, reverse transcriptase).
